Common Questions

Frequently asked questions

What SEO services do you offer?

The complete set: On-Page SEO, Keyword Research, Technical SEO, Off-Page SEO / link building, AEO & GEO for AI search, Local SEO with Google Business Profile optimisation, content writing & optimisation, and full SEO audits with monthly reporting.

Do you handle the complete SEO cycle?

Yes — the full cycle, from audit and strategy through execution to reporting: keyword research, on-page optimisation, technical fixes, link building, AEO/GEO and monthly performance reports.

Which businesses do you work with?

Local businesses and content websites — I specialise in Dubai & UAE businesses such as gyms, fitness centres and cleaning companies, and I run my own WordPress content site end to end.

Can you help my business show up on Google Maps?

Yes — Local SEO and Google Business Profile optimisation are core services: profile setup and optimisation, local keywords and location pages, so nearby customers find you first in Maps and "near me" searches.

Do you optimise for AI search, like ChatGPT and AI Overviews?

Yes. Alongside Google rankings, I optimise content to appear in AI answers — Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Gemini — using structured content, Quick Answer sections, FAQ coverage and clear, citable page structure.

How do you report results?

Through Google Search Console data, reported in a clear dashboard: impressions, average position, indexed pages and the work completed — so results are always visible, never vague.
